thread:
maria: heads-up — got an alert from the backup monitor: some snapshots in eu-west-2 look unsealed (not encrypted with the regional CMK).
enc-ops-bot: [ALERT] snapshot-seal-failure detected for tenant=tenant-42 region=eu-west-2 snapshot_id=sn-0a1b2c3d. EventCount=3.

maria: details: backup pipeline uploaded copies (replication) last night, but kms_reencrypt job failed on the secondary region. I can see objects without the `x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id` header.
jonathan: ack. can you paste the monitor output & the S3 HEAD response?
maria: pasted logs below:
```
2026-03-20T22:14:02Z upload: sn-0a1b2c3d.part -> s3://rbw-backups/eu-west-2/sn-0a1b2c3d.part
INFO: object metadata: {Content-Length: 32485712, SSE: None}
2026-03-20T22:15:10Z kms_reencrypt: start job for sn-0a1b2c3d -> target_key=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-2:1111:key/abcd-ef01
ERROR: KMS: AccessDenied when calling ReEncrypt
Trace: com.redwood.backup.KMSClient: access denied for principal arn:aws:iam::2222:role/backup-uploader
```
jonathan: that AccessDenied smells like a cross-account grant missing or the grant expired for the uploader role. who rotated keys/roles in the last 48h?
sam: I rotated a staging CMK on monday but not the uploader role. however we ran a mass grant prune last night as part of cleanup — might have dropped ephemeral grants.
laura: @sam did the prune target the eu-west-2 grant namespace? If so that would explain.
sam: yes, prune script ran across all regions with --old-grants-only. i assumed uploader had persistent grant, but maybe it was ephemeral.
maria: immediate ask — can we block restores and mark these snapshots as "hold" until we get them re-encrypted? We should avoid accidental restores to prod from unsealed copies.
jonathan: agree. action list: 1) set snapshot metadata flag `encryption_state=unsealed` 2) apply RBAC deny on restore endpoints for affected snapshot ids 3) try to re-encrypt via temporary Grant.
laura: I can push the RBAC deny rule. will need the list of snapshot ids. maria can you export?
maria: exporting now, sending as DM instead of channel.
enc-ops-bot: automation: created ticket REDW-ENC-4219 for snapshot sealing incident. Assigned to sam, priority=high.
sam: on it. immediate plan: request a KMS Grant for role `backup-uploader` in eu-west-2 using key policy fallback, then retry ReEncrypt with a one-hour grant.
jonathan: steps for temporary grant (for docs):
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/backup-eu-west-2 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::2222:role/backup-uploader --operations ReEncryptFrom ReEncryptTo Encrypt Decrypt --retiring-principal arn:aws:iam::1111:role/enc-admin
# save GrantId and retire after success
```
sam: trying to create grant now...
enc-ops-bot: [ACTION] created grant GrantId=gr-0z9y8x in eu-west-2 for principal arn:aws:iam::2222:role/backup-uploader (ttl=1h)
sam: reencrypt job retried: ReEncrypt succeeded for 8/12 objects, 4 still failing (AccessDenied on different key aliases).
maria: we still have four objects unsealed. any pattern?
jonathan: pattern: those objects were replicated from a cross-account tenant snapshot created 2025-11-12. tenant's original key is a different account CMK that we don't have re-encrypt perms for. We may need the tenant to create a grant or provide wrapped key material.
laura: escalate to security-oncall for cross-account coordination and to consider temporary restore block exceptions if tenant cooperation delayed.
security-oncall: I've joined. first priority: confirm we blocked restores and created audit entries. laura — can you confirm deny rule deployed?
laura: deny rule applied to /restore API for snapshot_ids: [sn-0a1b2c3d, sn-0d4e5f6g, sn-0h7i8j9k, sn-1a2b3c4d] — ruleset id enc-deny-4999. Logged event in audit stream.
security-oncall: good. next: we need a clear audit trail for compliance. maria — can you generate an audit bundle for the affected snapshots: upload events, KMS grant history, IAM principal changes for last 90 days? put in REDW-ENC-4219.
maria: will do, uploading to ticket.
johnathan: (typo fixed) jonathan: also note: our backup uploader service uses short-lived STS creds — confirm there was no STS assume-role expiry around 22:14. check CloudTrail for AssumeRole events.
sam: checked STS — no expiry. prune removed grants.
maria: mitigation options we discussed: 1) request tenant create grant (slow) 2) copy object and client-side re-encrypt using temporary KMS key (if policy allows) 3) if tenant refuses, mark snapshot archived and restrict access until expiration window.
jonathan: prefer path 2 if tenant keys permit CopyObject with SSE-KMS using our key as destination. Need to confirm original key allows ReEncryptTo our key. If not, must coordinate with tenant.
laura: compliance note: log retention for this incident should be 7 years per contract with tenant-42 — set retention on audit bundle.
security-oncall: also add to incident tracker: potential contractual breach if customer data is left unencrypted in backup copies. legal loop-in required.
maria: filing legal notify.
sam: running a sweep to rollback prune filters to prevent accidental grant deletion in the future. will add a safeguard that prevents pruning grants tagged `backup-persistent=true`.
jonathan: followup items for postmortem: - add canary to kms_reencrypt that verifies grant presence before finalizing replication - RBAC rule automation to auto-deny restores if encryption_state!=sealed - improve grant-prune script to skip uploader roles and keys used by replication.
laura: + add an alert on S3 object metadata missing SSE header during replication phase.
maria: thanks all. I'll keep channel updated once the remaining 4 objects are dealt with. :thumbsup:
enc-ops-bot: [UPDATE] REDW-ENC-4219 status -> in_progress.
security-oncall: noted. schedule a 30m war-room if we don't have tenant cooperation in 2 hours.
